areas.name: Herne Bay
areas.title: Herne Bay Real Estate Agent | Casey Green, Ray White
areas.description: Selling in Herne Bay? Casey Green has called greater Ponsonby home for 20+ years. Local, data-led advice and a free, no-obligation appraisal.
areas.tagline: Harbour-edge streets, grand villas and the Jervois Road village.
areas.lede: Herne Bay is one of Auckland’s most tightly held harbourside suburbs, and selling here rewards an agent who knows the difference a street, an aspect or a view line makes to what a buyer will pay.
about: Running down to the Waitematā Harbour between St Marys Bay and Westmere, Herne Bay pairs large character villas and Edwardian family homes with some of the city’s most considered contemporary architecture. The waterfront streets — Marine Parade, Sentinel Road, Argyle Street and their neighbours — sit alongside quieter, leafy streets rising up to Jervois Road.

Jervois Road is the suburb’s village: cafés, restaurants, a few long-standing local shops and the walk to Ponsonby Road. Small harbour beaches sit at the foot of several streets, and the city is a short drive or bus ride away.
highlights: Harbour frontage and views along the northern streets
Character villas and Edwardian homes on generous inner-city sites
The Jervois Road village, a short walk from Ponsonby Road
Bayfield School, where Casey’s daughters went to school
areas.selling: Herne Bay buyers are well informed and often comparing a handful of very different homes, so presentation, positioning and timing matter as much as the price guide. Casey’s family ties to Bayfield School and two decades in the neighbourhood give her a working knowledge of who is looking here and why.

faqs.q: What is my Herne Bay home worth?
faqs.a: Values in Herne Bay move street by street, and with aspect, site and views, so a suburb average says very little about a particular home. Casey prepares a free, no-obligation appraisal based on recent comparable sales and what she is seeing from buyers right now.

faqs.q: What is the best way to sell a home in Herne Bay?
faqs.a: That depends on the home and the buyers it will attract. Auction, a deadline sale or a negotiated sale can each be right; Casey recommends a method once she has seen the property and understands your timing.

faqs.q: Does Casey sell in the suburbs around Herne Bay?
faqs.a: Yes. Casey works across greater Ponsonby and the city fringe, including Ponsonby, St Marys Bay, Freemans Bay, Grey Lynn, Westmere and Point Chevalier.

areas.name: Ponsonby
areas.title: Ponsonby Real Estate Agent | Casey Green, Ray White
areas.description: Ponsonby real estate agent Casey Green, Ray White Auckland Central. 20+ years living in greater Ponsonby. Book a free, no-obligation property appraisal.
areas.tagline: Restored villas, Ponsonby Road and the best-known postcode in the city fringe.
areas.lede: Casey has called greater Ponsonby home for more than two decades. She knows its streets the way a local does — which ones hold their value, which ones buyers ask for by name, and why.
about: Ponsonby’s streets of restored Victorian and Edwardian villas run off either side of Ponsonby Road, one of Auckland’s best-known strips for dining, design and fashion. Closer to the road you’ll find terraced homes, townhouses and apartments; further back, quieter tree-lined streets that families stay in for decades.
Western Park sits within the suburb, the Three Lamps village at its northern end, and local schools and the city centre are a short walk or bus ride away.
highlights: Some of Auckland’s best-preserved villa streets
Ponsonby Road and the Three Lamps village on the doorstep
Western Park, local schools and an easy commute to the city
Recent Ponsonby sales include 45 Pompallier Terrace and 25 Bayfield Road
areas.selling: Ponsonby draws buyers from across Auckland and overseas, and the right campaign gets a home in front of the people already watching the suburb. Casey combines sales data, current market conditions and buyer psychology to position each home, then uses her local networks to bring competing buyers to the table.

faqs.q: What is my Ponsonby home worth?
faqs.a: Two villas on the same street can sell a long way apart, depending on renovation, land, parking and outlook. Casey’s free appraisal looks at the comparable sales that genuinely match your home, and at what buyers are paying now.

faqs.q: How long does it take to sell a home in Ponsonby?
faqs.a: It varies with the market, the home and the method of sale. Casey will give you a realistic timeline at your appraisal, and a campaign plan to match it.

faqs.q: Does Casey sell apartments and townhouses in Ponsonby as well as villas?
faqs.a: Yes — villas, family homes, townhouses and apartments across Ponsonby and the neighbouring suburbs.

areas.name: Grey Lynn
areas.title: Grey Lynn Real Estate Agent | Casey Green, Ray White
areas.description: Grey Lynn real estate agent Casey Green has sold homes on Sackville, Warnock, Dickens and Tutanekai Streets. Free, no-obligation appraisals.
areas.tagline: Villas and bungalows, Grey Lynn Park and a real village feel.
areas.lede: Grey Lynn is where much of Casey’s recent work has been: villas and family homes on Sackville Street, Warnock Street, Dickens Street, Tutanekai Street and Old Mill Road.
about: Grey Lynn’s gently rolling streets are lined with villas and bungalows, many of them renovated and extended for modern family life, alongside newer townhouses and infill homes. Grey Lynn Park sits at the heart of the suburb, with the shops and cafés of West Lynn, Richmond Road and Surrey Crescent close by.
Local primary schools are close by, Western Springs is a short walk away, and Ponsonby Road and the city are easily reached by road, bus or bike.
highlights: Classic villas and bungalows on family-friendly streets
Grey Lynn Park, West Lynn and Richmond Road
Easy access to Western Springs, Ponsonby and the city
Casey’s recent Grey Lynn sales are listed below
areas.selling: Grey Lynn buyers often come from Ponsonby, Westmere and further afield, and many are families stepping up into a first character home. Casey’s approach is analytical — pricing and positioning built on real sales evidence — and personal, with clear communication from the first conversation to settlement.

faqs.q: What is my Grey Lynn home worth?
faqs.a: Casey will prepare a free, no-obligation appraisal using the Grey Lynn sales that genuinely compare with your home, adjusted for its land, condition and street.

faqs.q: Is now a good time to sell in Grey Lynn?
faqs.a: The answer depends on your own plans as much as the market. Casey will talk you through current buyer activity, your timing and the options for buying and selling back to back.

faqs.q: Does Casey help with buying and selling at the same time?
faqs.a: Yes. Several of Casey’s clients have bought and sold in a back-to-back deal; she can plan a campaign around your next purchase.

areas.name: St Marys Bay
areas.title: St Marys Bay Real Estate Agent | Casey Green, Ray White
areas.description: St Marys Bay real estate agent Casey Green, Ray White Auckland Central. Harbour-view villas and apartments by the city. Free, no-obligation appraisal.
areas.tagline: Small, harbourside and minutes from the city.
areas.lede: St Marys Bay is one of the smallest suburbs in the city fringe and one of the most tightly held, which makes every sale here worth getting exactly right.
about: Tucked between Herne Bay and Freemans Bay, St Marys Bay looks north over Westhaven Marina and the Harbour Bridge. Its streets hold Victorian and Edwardian villas, some on steep, view-rich sites, along with a handful of apartment and townhouse developments.
The Westhaven waterfront, Wynyard Quarter and the city centre are all within walking distance, with Ponsonby Road a short stroll in the other direction.
highlights: Harbour and bridge views from many streets
Character villas close to the city centre
Walking distance to Westhaven, Wynyard Quarter and Ponsonby Road
areas.selling: With so few homes coming up for sale in St Marys Bay, buyers who want to be here are often waiting for the right one. Casey’s job is to reach them, present the home at its best and create the competition that sets the price.

faqs.q: What is my St Marys Bay home worth?
faqs.a: Views, aspect and access make a big difference here, so Casey appraises each home on its own merits, using recent comparable sales in St Marys Bay and the neighbouring suburbs.

faqs.q: Can I sell my St Marys Bay home without a big public campaign?
faqs.a: Talk to Casey about your options. Some sellers prefer a quieter approach to known buyers first; she will explain the trade-offs honestly.

faqs.q: Which suburbs near St Marys Bay does Casey cover?
faqs.a: Herne Bay, Ponsonby, Freemans Bay, Grey Lynn, Westmere and Point Chevalier.

areas.name: Freemans Bay
areas.title: Freemans Bay Real Estate Agent | Casey Green, Ray White
areas.description: Freemans Bay real estate agent Casey Green — cottages, villas, townhouses and apartments beside the city. View current listings or book a free appraisal.
areas.tagline: Cottages, villas and apartments on the edge of the city.
areas.lede: Freemans Bay sits right on the edge of the city centre, and its mix of workers’ cottages, villas, townhouses and apartments attracts a wide range of buyers. Casey is currently marketing a home on Hopetoun Street.
about: Between Ponsonby and the city, Freemans Bay is home to Victoria Park, the villas and cottages of Franklin Road — famous for its Christmas lights — and quiet streets that feel a world away from Queen Street, just a few minutes’ walk east.

Its housing ranges from restored cottages on small sites to family villas, modern townhouses and apartment buildings with city and harbour views. Freemans Bay School, Western Park and Ponsonby Road are all close by.
highlights: Walking distance to the city centre and Ponsonby Road
Franklin Road, Victoria Park and Western Park
Cottages, villas, townhouses and apartments
Recent Freemans Bay sale: 2E/8 Howe Street
areas.selling: Freemans Bay buyers range from first-home buyers and downsizers to families and investors, and each needs reaching in a different way. Casey tailors every campaign to the buyers a home will actually attract.

faqs.q: What is my Freemans Bay home or apartment worth?
faqs.a: Casey’s free appraisal compares your home with recent sales of similar cottages, villas, townhouses or apartments in and around Freemans Bay.

faqs.q: Does Casey sell apartments in Freemans Bay?
faqs.a: Yes. Casey markets apartments and townhouses as well as houses, and is currently marketing an apartment on Hopetoun Street.

faqs.q: How do I see Casey’s current Freemans Bay listings?
faqs.a: They are listed on this page and on her listings page, with links through to full details, photos and open-home times on Ray White.

areas.name: Westmere
areas.title: Westmere Real Estate Agent | Casey Green, Ray White
areas.description: Westmere real estate agent Casey Green has sold homes on Cumberland Avenue, Kotare Avenue and Richard Street. Free, no-obligation appraisals.
areas.tagline: Bays, parks and family streets between Herne Bay and Point Chevalier.
areas.lede: Westmere is one of the suburbs where Casey has sold most often, with recent sales on Cumberland Avenue, Kotare Avenue and Richard Street.
about: Westmere wraps around the harbour edge between Herne Bay and Point Chevalier, with Coxs Bay, Westmere Park and the Meola Reef Reserve all close at hand. Its streets mix villas and bungalows with substantial modern family homes, many on larger sites than the inner suburbs offer.
Westmere School is local, the West End Road shops serve day-to-day needs, and Western Springs, Auckland Zoo and MOTAT are just up the road.
highlights: Family homes on generous sites, close to the water
Coxs Bay, Westmere Park and Meola Reef
Close to Western Springs, Grey Lynn and Ponsonby
Casey’s recent Westmere sales are listed below
areas.selling: Westmere attracts families moving up from Grey Lynn and Ponsonby as well as buyers wanting more land close to the city. Casey’s local networks and steady flow of Westmere buyers help generate the competition that lifts a price.

faqs.q: What is my Westmere home worth?
faqs.a: Casey has sold several Westmere homes recently and will prepare a free, no-obligation appraisal based on the sales that genuinely compare with yours.

faqs.q: What do buyers look for in Westmere?
faqs.a: Usually space, family living and easy access to the water and parks. Casey will talk you through how to present your home to the buyers most likely to want it.

faqs.q: Does Casey also sell in Point Chevalier and Grey Lynn?
faqs.a: Yes, along with Herne Bay, Ponsonby, St Marys Bay and Freemans Bay.

areas.name: Point Chevalier
areas.title: Point Chevalier Real Estate Agent | Casey Green, Ray White
areas.description: Point Chevalier real estate agent Casey Green has sold on Kiwi Road, Walmer Road and Riro Street. Book a free, no-obligation property appraisal.
areas.tagline: A beachside peninsula with a strong community and family homes.
areas.lede: Point Chevalier’s beach, parks and family streets have made it one of the inner west’s most popular suburbs. Casey’s recent sales here include Kiwi Road, Walmer Road and Riro Street.
about: Point Chevalier sits on its own peninsula, with Point Chevalier Beach and Coyle Park at its tip and the Meola Reef Reserve along its eastern edge. Its streets hold bungalows, villas, state-house-era homes and a growing number of modern townhouses and rebuilds.
The shops and cafés along Point Chevalier Road and Great North Road serve the suburb, Point Chevalier School is local, and the motorway, cycleway and Western Springs are all close by.
highlights: Point Chevalier Beach, Coyle Park and Meola Reef
Family homes, from bungalows to modern rebuilds
Quick access to the city, the motorway and Western Springs
Recent sales on Kiwi Road, Walmer Road and Riro Street
areas.selling: Point Chevalier buyers are often families who know exactly which streets and school zones they want. Casey positions each home for the buyers already looking, and keeps you informed at every step.

faqs.q: What is my Point Chevalier home worth?
faqs.a: Casey will prepare a free, no-obligation appraisal based on recent Point Chevalier sales that genuinely compare with your home.

faqs.q: Should I renovate before selling my Point Chevalier home?
faqs.a: Sometimes a little preparation pays for itself and sometimes it doesn’t. Casey will give you an honest view of what is worth doing before you go to market.

faqs.q: Which suburbs near Point Chevalier does Casey cover?
faqs.a: Westmere, Grey Lynn, Herne Bay, Ponsonby, St Marys Bay and Freemans Bay — and she has recently sold in Waterview too.
